goal: Start a fast leader kill while accepting a bounded opening HP loss.
guidance: The leader is the valuable target: its death dismisses both followers. Current best tempo is Bludgeon into Kin Priest for 42 using all three energy. Spending energy on Armaments or Headbutt first prevents that burst. Incoming is 14 and end-turn Plating is 4, so accepting 10 HP here is affordable at 79 HP. Do not split damage into full-health followers. The program manages Blood Potion; evaluate fresh states after plays and end only when useful actions are exhausted.
